product_summary: Pure software/SaaS company (agri-tech platform, rebranded as 'Verdnt', formerly KhetiBuddy). Real product lines per own website (khetibuddy.com, /about-us, /platform/farm-management-software, /industries/agri-input): Farm Management Software, Remote Sensing / satellite crop monitoring, M-Commerce module for agri-input sales, Crop Advisory, Outgrower/Contract Farming management, Sourcing & Post-Harvest Supply Chain Management, Farm-to-Fork Traceability, Digital Marketplace, Agri ERP / Financial Management, Sustainability & Carbon (DMRV) management. Delivered as web platform + executive mobile app + grower mobile app, sold on subscription/demo basis ('Book a Demo'). No physical goods, no hardware, no agri-input trading of its own — IoT/weather-station integration is a software integration, not a goods line.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader is not applicable; effectively a software vendor / service provider (SaaS). No trader signs, no goods catalogue, no IndiaMART-style product listings.
comment: HS 997331 ('Licensing services for the right to use computer software') matches the actual business exactly — the company licenses its own agri-tech SaaS platform. Source: khetibuddy.com homepage and About Us page ('Verdnt (formerly KhetiBuddy), an AI-native agri intelligence platform'), platform pages listing software modules only. No industry misclassification: the 'agritech' name could mislead a researcher into agri-input/commodity codes (e.g. 3105 fertilisers, 3808 pesticides, 1209 seeds), but the company sells no such goods — it only serves agri-input companies as software clients. Optional secondary codes if implementation/customisation/support is invoiced separately: 998313 (IT consulting and support) and 998314 (IT design and development services). All product claims are website-declared only; no customs line was available to me in this task, so shipment-level corroboration is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — however, for a SaaS licensor the absence of goods shipment records is expected and is not a discrepancy. No rejection grounds under Rule 3; verdict accepted, HS confirmed as declared.
